title: LC-MS/DAD/ELSD quality check of a DMSO compound library in 384-well plates
summary: Analytical QC of a large DMSO-stored compound collection: stock plates are thawed, diluted to a few mM, and injected on a short fast-gradient run with DAD, ELSD and CLND detection; identity needs mass adducts and purity/concentration come from calibrated universal detectors.

steps.text: Thaw 384-well plates of 20 mM DMSO stocks without heating, sonicate briefly and centrifuge.
Dilute stocks to roughly 3 mM for analysis.
Place the plate directly in the autosampler.
Run a C18 column (50 x 3.0 mm, 2.5 um, 50 C) with water/methanol containing 0.1% acetic acid, 5-100% B in 3 min then hold 0.3 min at 1.5 mL/min.

duration_s.note: 3 min gradient + 0.3 min hold = 3.3 min stated; equilibration not included.

steps.text: Quantify purity and concentration from ELSD and CLND signals via linear calibration curves.
Call identity only if the expected adduct masses appear consistently across detectors.

equipment.name: Agilent 1100/1200 HPLC with DAD, ELSD, CLND and MS

materials: 20 mM DMSO stock plates, water, methanol, acetic acid
notes: Tox21 environmental/drug library, not a synthetic library; the method is generic. Catalog ids are suggested equivalents; the paper used an Agilent HPLC with CLND.
